channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: A longtime Killington town employee filed a police report after a heated confrontation with a Select Board member. The dispute centered on employee benefits and workplace treatment. Town leaders discussed the matter but have yet to take formal action.

Police are looking for a driver who hit a pedestrian near an elementary school in West Fairlee Tuesday night. The driver and vehicle remain unidentified. Authorities urge anyone with information to come forward.

Bat populations in Essex County are rebounding after near collapse from white-nose syndrome. Scientists are tracking their survival and movements in the Barton Hill Mines. These bats play a vital role in controlling pests and supporting local ecosystems.

Rutland City voters will decide on a new capital reserve fund for school improvements. The fund won't raise taxes but will help cover building repairs and upgrades. An informational meeting is set for November second ahead of Election Day.
